title: Untrack AI-generated documentation from the repository

completion_criteria.text: Audit git tracking and identify every AI-generated document that should not be tracked, separated from real configuration.
Untrack those documents without deleting them from disk, and add ignore rules so the trees cannot creep back.
Repair any live consumer the untracking broke, proven green on a pristine clone rather than the live checkout.
Open a pull request carrying the change, with an honest verification section.

spine.active_goal: The repository tracks actual configuration only; assistant-generated documents stay on disk and out of git.
spine.next_step: Merge pull request 252 after reading its CI checks directly — the test workflow is not a required status check on this repository, so a red pull request will still merge on one click. Then start the filed follow-up: enumerate tracked programs no CI job invokes, and repair the two tracked prose files that cite now-absent paths.
spine.last_session: Audited tracking, untracked 92 documents while keeping them on disk, extracted the retired agent roster into tracked config after the untracking broke a gate and two tests, and opened pull request 252.

open_risks.text: Read the checks on pull request 252 before merging — the test workflow is not a required status check here, so GitHub will merge a red pull request on one click.

A tracked program can still read a path into the untracked document trees and go unnoticed if no CI job runs it — a text search cannot find these reliably, because the one consumer that was missed builds its path from two separate string literals.

key_decisions.title: Untrack the AI-generated documents without rewriting history or deleting them
Extract the retired agent roster into tracked config rather than re-tracking the design document

out_of_scope: Extending CI coverage to tracked programs no CI job currently invokes, and repairing tracked prose that cites now-absent paths — filed as its own unit.
The modified sound file sitting in the working tree, which predates this work and was never staged.
